profile.headline: Senior Principal Software Engineer at NASA Ames Research Center
profile.jobTitle: Senior Principal Software Engineer, Airspace Operations Laboratory
profile.summary:
Highly accomplished Software Engineer with 35 years of experience in Software Development. Proven success in the design and implementation of robust, scalable, and efficient software that is well-documented, easy to maintain, and intuitive to use. Comprehensive knowledge of the full software life cycle.

Equally effective as a solo contributor, team member, or project lead, with international experience working in China, Brazil, Sweden, and Germany. I have broad experience encompassing global corporations, government, mid-sized companies, and small start-ups.

Creative, detail-oriented, and organized team player with strong communication skills, a commitment to reliability, and the ability to prioritize and stay focused under pressure. Recognized for mentorship, tenacity, and a positive, friendly attitude.
